exportAboutMany: Each checked item is saved as its own file in the same folder.
exportAboutSettings: Lists confirmed lore by category, leaving out pending lore.
exportAboutOutline: Lists the outline of each volume and chapter in order.
exportAboutWord: The title page shows the book name, pen name and character count. Each chapter starts on a new page.
exportAboutText: Combined into one file, with a heading before each volume and chapter.
exportSkipBody: There are no chapters yet, so the text won’t be exported.
exportSkipOutlineNone: There are no chapters yet, so the outline won’t be exported.
exportSkipOutlineEmpty: No chapter outlines have been written in this range, so the outline won’t be exported.
exportSkipSettings: No confirmed lore yet, so lore won’t be exported.
exportPenHint: Optional. Shown on the title page.
exportIndent: Indent paragraphs with two full-width spaces
exportedMany: Exported {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to {folder}
